text: E Luutu Men Okki mo serndugol ñaawoore nden hakkunde wennjiiɓe ɓen, Men Okki mo kadi Ganndal e fiyaake Diina makko, Men Hisini mo kadi immorde e lepte ɗi Men jippini ɗen e dow saare makko nden (Saduuma) nde yimɓe mu'un laatinoo no huuwa boneeji ɗin, pellet, kamɓe ɓe laatinoke yimɓe bonɓe yaltuɓe e ɗoftaare Joomi maɓɓe.
